fields.name: token
fields.label: Personal access token
fields.note: Generate a token in Account → Access Tokens. A scoped token reaches only the organizations, projects, and permissions you choose; set an expiration date.

config.hint: Use SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN with the Supabase CLI or as a Bearer token for the Management API at https://api.supabase.com/v1. The token's scope determines the available organizations and projects.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Project URL
fields.note: Copy the project URL from the project's Settings → Data API.

fields.name: secretKey
fields.label: Secret key
fields.note: Create a secret key in the project's Settings → API Keys. It bypasses Row Level Security; use it only on servers.

fields.name: publishableKey
fields.label: Publishable key (optional)
fields.note: Copy the publishable key from the same page if your application also uses it.

config.hint: Use SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY with Supabase client libraries, or send the key in the apikey header to the project's APIs. The secret key bypasses Row Level Security.

fields.name: projectId
fields.label: Project ID
fields.note: Copy the project ID from the project's Settings → General.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Database password
fields.note: Use the password set for the project's database. Reset it in the project's Database settings if you do not have it.

config.hint: Use SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID and SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD with the Supabase CLI, together with SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN from an access token connection, for commands such as supabase db push.
